channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: PSOL quer esvaziar discurso de Flávio Bolsonaro sobre o pix
item.description: Federal deputy Duda Salabert (PSOL-MG) proposed awarding the National Order of Merit to Banco Central employees responsible for creating Pix, in response to criticisms by Flávio Bolsonaro. The initiative aims to recognize Brazil’s technological innovation and counter political narratives questioning Pix’s security or origins.

item.title: Nova lei cria primeira universidade federal dedicada ao esporte
item.description: President Lula signed Law 15.457/26, establishing the Federal University of Sport (UFEsporte), the first federal higher education institution exclusively dedicated to sport, with headquarters in Brasília. The university aims to train professionals for sports management, train athletes, promote inclusion in parasports, and ensure education for athletes in transition or dual careers, alongside gender and racial equity initiatives.

item.title: Governo: decisão dos EUA sobre PCC e CV não traz benefícios concretos
item.description: The Brazilian government states that the U.S. designation of PCC and CV as terrorist organizations brings no concrete benefits and could lead to unilateral American measures, including potential military action in Brazil. Itamaraty warns of financial, migratory, and penal risks for Brazilian citizens, emphasizing the defense of national sovereignty.

item.title: Senador bolsonarista usa festa junina para associar PT a "quadrilha"
item.description: Senator Jorge Seif (PL-SC) shared a WhatsApp story featuring a June festival-themed image associating the PT with the term 'quadrilha' (gang), implying the party is linked to organized crime. The post was made on July 2 and remained visible in Stories. In June, Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça had already ordered the removal of similar content posted by deputy Sóstenes Cavalcante (PL-RJ).

item.title: Defesa de Lulinha aciona PF e tenta arquivar inquérito por ‘falta de justa causa’ antes das eleições
item.description: The defense of Fabio Luis Lula da Silva (Lulinha) plans to request the dismissal of the PF investigation into alleged INSS discount frauds, citing lack of just cause, and aims to act before the 2026 elections to avoid damaging President Lula’s campaign. Lawyers Marco Aurélio Carvalho and Guilherme Suguimori are set to meet with PF Director-General Andrei Passos before filing a habeas corpus. Although the PF indicated that analysis of Lulinha’s data will only occur in 2027 due to prioritization of detainees and those under restrictive measures, the defense denies attempting to 'jump the queue' and asserts there is no basis to maintain the investigation.

item.title: Dossiê sobre tarifas e Pix enviado ao governo Trump amplia desgaste de Flávio Bolsonaro entre eleitores decisivos, aponta pesquisa
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro sent an 86-page dossier to the U.S. government requesting a 180-day suspension of tariffs on Brazilian products until after the 2026 elections, which provoked a negative reaction among swing voters. According to the Instituto Democracia em Xeque, the PL pre-candidate is losing trust and narrative autonomy among this decisive voter segment.

item.title: Dino e Moraes dão 48 horas para tribunais explicarem pagamentos a magistrados
item.description: Supreme Court ministers Alexandre de Moraes and Flávio Dino ordered the presidents of six state Courts of Justice to explain, within 48 hours, payments made to active, retired, and pensioner judges between April and July 2026, following a report that at least seven state tribunals circumvented the Court’s limits on 'penduricalhos'. The ruling requires individualized breakdowns of remunerative and indemnity payments, plus copies of payroll slips, to verify compliance with the March STF decision capping such bonuses at 35% of ministers’ salaries. The move aims to prevent payments exceeding the functional ceiling—up to 78,000 reais—as the 2026 elections approach.

item.title: A nova pesquisa Ideia para testar o desempenho de Michelle Bolsonaro
item.description: The Ideia Institute will release a poll with 1,500 interviews (margin of error: 2.5 pp) assessing Michelle Bolsonaro’s presidential prospects in 2026. The survey will test scenarios with and without Flávio Bolsonaro, including a hypothetical runoff against Lula, and evaluate voter reactions to Michelle’s video criticizing her stepson.

item.title: Indústria teme que atuação de Flávio nos EUA dificulte negociação sobre tarifas
item.description: National industry representatives express concern over Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) participation in U.S. hearings regarding proposed increases in import tariffs on Brazilian goods. His presence and potential statements could complicate ongoing trade negotiations, as his stance is seen as potentially conflicting with sectoral interests.

item.title: Eliminação do Brasil na Copa muda retorno do Brasileirão? Veja quando o campeonato volta
item.description: Brazil's World Cup elimination does not change the Brasileirão Série A schedule, which resumes on July 16, three days before the World Cup final. The CBF maintained its pre-planned calendar to minimize disruption, with the 19th round set for July 16, featuring matches like Botafogo vs Santos and Vitória vs Vasco. The resumption occurs while the World Cup is still ongoing, allowing clubs without international players to continue and concluding the first round before the tournament's end.

item.title: Como Flávio, Eduardo e mais aliados de Bolsonaro associaram a derrota da seleção brasileira a Lula
item.description: Bolsonaro allies, including Flávio and Eduardo Bolsonaro, linked Brazil's World Cup loss to Lula's government, using social media to turn sports frustration into political gain. They posted messages tying the team's title drought to PT governments, shared montages of Bolsonaro holding the trophy, and held live streams, while other PL deputies referenced PT electoral numbers and judicial decisions to politicize the outcome. The strategy was described as an attempt to capitalize on public dissatisfaction amid high polarization.

item.title: Famosos que comemoraram derrota de Neymar e Brasil na Copa
item.description: Following Brazil's 2-1 loss to Norway in the 2026 World Cup, numerous celebrities took to social media to express a range of reactions, including sorrow, support for the players, criticism of Neymar, and celebration of his retirement. Figures such as Ary Fontoura, Adriane Galisteu, Simaria, João Gomes, Luciano Huck, Maísa Silva, Zé Felipe, Erika Januza, and Luana Piovani commented on the result, highlighting collective frustration and debates over the team’s performance and Neymar’s role.

item.title: Direita dá tiro no pé ao focar impeachment do STF, povão quer fim da 6x1, diz nova líder de Lula no Senado
item.description: The new Lula government leader in the Senate, Teresa Leitão (PT-PE), claims the right is making a strategic mistake by focusing on impeaching Supreme Court ministers in the 2026 Senate campaign. She argues that ending the 6x1 work schedule will be an electoral advantage for the left, even if the PEC is not approved before the elections.

item.title: Cenário em SP aumenta peso eleitoral de Tarcísio na eleição presidencial
item.description: The possibility of Tarcísio de Freitas winning the São Paulo gubernatorial election in the first round increases his electoral weight in the 2026 presidential race, according to leaders from Lula’s and Flávio Bolsonaro’s camps. While Bolsonaro allies see him as key to defeating Lula, PT allies believe he may remain passive ('corpo mole') to position himself for 2030, especially given his proposed PEC to ban presidential re-election. Datafolha shows Tarcísio with 46% of voting intentions but 52% of valid votes — enough to win in the first round within the margin of error.

item.title: Suspense de Michelle Bolsonaro amplia crise no PL em um momento de definição
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro's Senate candidacy for the Federal District remains uncertain following public conflicts with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, prompting her to consider withdrawing. PL leaders, including Damares Alves and Celina Leão, are working to convince her to stay in the race, viewing her as a key vote-getter for the party. July will be decisive, with party conventions beginning on July 20.

item.title: STF nega pedido da Assembleia do Paraná e cassação de Renato Freitas segue suspensa
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Edson Fachin denied a petition from the Paraná Legislative Assembly and kept suspended the vote on the cassation request against state deputy Renato Freitas (PT-PR), accused of parliamentary misconduct following a street fight in November 2025. The decision is monocratic and awaits validation by the full STF plenary, while the Alep stated it will appeal for the case to be reviewed by the entire Court. The process remains under seal, with Freitas claiming political persecution despite the Ethics Committee’s recommendation for cassation.

item.title: Vote no gol mais bonito da fase de 16 avos
item.description: The article features five goals selected by commentators of VEJA's 'Bola na Copa' program as the most beautiful from the round of 16 of the 2026 World Cup. Candidates include Gabriel Martinelli (Brazil), Kylian Mbappé (France), Ismaïla Sarr (Senegal), Gonçalo Ramos (Portugal), and Sidny Cabral (Cabo Verde). Each goal is described with details of the play, match context, and image, emphasizing technique, creativity, and visual impact. The public is invited to vote for the most beautiful goal of the stage.

item.title: Ibovespa cai com início de negociações do tarifaço
item.description: The Ibovespa fell 1.21% on Monday as investors monitored the start of U.S.-Brazil trade talks over potential tariffs of up to 37.5% on Brazilian goods, citing concerns over PIX, deforestation, piracy, and alleged slave labor conditions. The CNI projects that 4,187 Brazilian products, worth $14.9 billion in exports, could be affected. Markets are also awaiting the FOMC minutes and Brazilian inflation data, while the 2026 IPCA forecast was slightly lowered to 5.30%.

item.title: Cinco minutos para argumentação, perguntas e registro oficial: como funcionará a audiência nos EUA que ouvirá Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) will testify on Tuesday in a USTR public hearing regarding a potential 25% tariff on Brazilian goods, following his submission of an 86-page document requesting tariff suspension and exclusion of Pix from the trade dispute. He argues the tariff would politically strengthen Lula and advocates for targeted sanctions against individuals instead of broad economic measures. Brazil did not send official representatives, viewing the hearing as private-sector focused, while maintaining parallel diplomatic negotiations.

item.title: Fotógrafo de Lula há 23 anos, Ricardo Stuckert deixa o Palácio do Planalto
item.description: Ricardo Stuckert, Lula’s longtime photographer of 23 years, has resigned from the Presidency’s Secretariat of Social Communication, effective retroactively from July 4, the start of the electoral blackout period. The move, published in the Official Gazette, is part of the reorganization of Lula’s team ahead of his 2026 reelection campaign, with expectations that Stuckert will join the party structure to oversee social media strategy. Two other officials — Vinicius Carnier Colombin and Anna Maria Menezes Vieira da Costa — were also discharged from their roles in Secom and the Presidency’s Personal Office.

item.title: Eliminação da seleção expõe dissonância cognitiva da vida pública nacional
item.description: The elimination of the Brazilian national football team reflects a national cognitive dissonance, where sporting symbolism mirrors political and social crises, such as glorification of the past, lack of leadership renewal, and reliance on narratives of greatness or victimization. The article uses Neymar as a symbol of a generation that ostentates more than it delivers, amplified by social media and the attention economy, paralleling political stagnation under leaders like Lula, whose era is seen as compensatory, without structural transformation.

item.title: Gols de Haaland contra o Brasil levam Copa a feito inédito na artilharia: nunca três jogadores fizeram 7 gols na mesma edição
item.description: Erling Haaland scored two goals against Brazil, reaching seven in the 2026 World Cup and tying Lionel Messi and Kylian Mbappé for the tournament lead — the first time in history three players have reached seven or more goals in a single edition. Brazil's elimination in the round of 16 became the backdrop for this unprecedented feat, while Harry Kane, with six goals, remains in contention for the Golden Boot. The tournament now features a historic goal-scoring race with potential to break new records.

item.title: Flávio intensifica disputa contra Lula e vai aos EUA para negociar tarifas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, senator and presidential pre-candidate, travels to Washington to negotiate delaying a proposed 25% US tariff on Brazilian goods. He argues the tariffs would politically benefit Lula’s government, while Lula accuses him of helping trigger the measures — a claim Bolsonaro denies. The trip aligns with Trump’s growing engagement in Latin America and Bolsonaro’s strategy to frame foreign trade as a central election issue.

item.title: Flávio e Eduardo Bolsonaro politizam derrota do Brasil na Copa e dizem que foi culpa do PT
item.description: Flávio and Eduardo Bolsonaro linked Brazil's 2026 World Cup loss to the Workers' Party (PT) government, claiming that since 2002 the country has won nothing — neither in football nor for its citizens. Flávio, a presidential pre-candidate, posted on social media with the Brazilian flag, stating 'we will win Brazil,' while Eduardo repeated the narrative, tying Brazil's lack of titles to Lula's presidency. Other Bolsonarist figures, such as Sóstenes Cavalcante and Carlos Portinho, also politicized the match, drawing symbolic connections to the STF and CBF.

item.title: E Sidônio vai ficando...
item.description: Ricardo Stuckert, Lula’s official photographer and former head of Audiovisual Production at Secom, was dismissed to join the reelection campaign as social media coordinator. Sidônio Palmeira, tipped to lead the campaign’s marketing, remains in charge of Secom through at least the first round, with a possible move to the campaign between rounds. Lula also appointed Raul Rabelo to oversee the campaign, but under his direct supervision.

item.title: Jair Renan Bolsonaro anuncia pré-candidatura a deputado federal por Santa Catarina
item.description: Jair Renan Bolsonaro, councilor of Balneário Camboriú and son of former president Jair Bolsonaro, announced his pre-candidacy for federal deputy from Santa Catarina in a social media post. He stated his campaign is alongside patriots who believe in a strong, free, and prosperous Brazil. Renan was elected councilor in 2024 and, although he became a defendant in a money laundering and document falsification case, the criminal action was stayed by the STJ in February 2025.

item.title: Nikolas provoca Lula e elogia Neymar após derrota do Brasil na Copa
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) criticized President Lula and praised Neymar after Brazil's World Cup elimination, reviving the controversy over Lula's remark calling Neymar a 'home office player'. Ferreira said Neymar 'took responsibility for himself' by scoring Brazil's only goal in the 2-1 loss to Norway, suggesting that if Neymar had taken the penalty earlier, he would not have missed. He concluded by saying he 'just wants Lula to suffer'.

item.title: Esposa de Flávio Bolsonaro entrará na campanha
item.description: Fernanda Bolsonaro, wife of Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), will take a more central role in the presidential campaign following accusations from stepmother Michelle of abuse and disrespect. She will undergo media training this month and may have her own social media team, focusing on health and targeting women, given her orthodontics specialization.

item.title: O aceno de paz de Alcolumbre ao governo Lula em matéria polêmica defendida por oposição
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre is expected to reject the opposition's push to fast-track the homeschooling regulation bill, keeping it off the Senate's priority agenda. This stance is interpreted as a peace overture to President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, who opposes the measure, despite ongoing political tensions since November last year. Alcolumbre has previously inflicted defeats on Lula's government in key votes, underscoring his strategic independence.

item.title: Nikolas queria Neymar desde o início do jogo
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) posted a video lamenting Brazil's elimination from the 2026 World Cup, praising Neymar Jr. and criticizing President Lula, stating that the striker should have played from the start to improve the team's performance.

item.title: Tarifaço: governo Lula rebate acusações e vê ação política dos EUA
item.description: The Lula government rebutted U.S. allegations of unfair trade practices, including claims about Pix, stating there is no legal basis to justify 25% tariffs under Section 301. The document sent to the USTR defends Brazilian sovereignty, cites STF actions, and denies that Pix excludes foreign firms. While the government will not attend the hearing, Brazilian industry and agribusiness sectors will voice concerns about the economic impact of proposed tariffs on both countries.

item.title: Empresariado liga alerta para atuação de Flávio em audiência nos EUA
item.description: Brazilian business leaders are concerned about Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) participation in a U.S. hearing on a trade investigation that could lead to tariffs of up to 25% on Brazilian exports. They fear his advocacy for a 'zero-zero' reciprocity model on ethanol and sugar tariffs may weaken Brazil's negotiating position and politicize technical discussions. The meeting, held this Monday (July 6), includes U.S. officials, industry representatives, and the senator as a witness.

item.title: Brasil fora da Copa: Moro critica Gilmar e Nikolas defende Neymar
item.description: Following Brazil's elimination from the 2026 World Cup by Norway, politicians from both the right and left expressed their views on social media. Sergio Moro (PL-PR) criticized Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes, claiming the CBF 'controlled by Gilmar cannot succeed'. Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) defended Neymar, blamed Lula as the 'home office player', and told him to 'go to hell'. Adolfo Sachsida compared Ancelotti's coaching to the Lula government, while Kim Kataguiri called Brazil a 'shitty country' and said not even football could be a source of pride.

item.title: Contratado até 2030, Ancelotti promete lidar com a tristeza e recomeçar
item.description: Italian coach Carlo Ancelotti, hired until 2030 to lead the Brazilian national team, said after the 2026 World Cup elimination by Norway that he will cope with the disappointment and restart, emphasizing the current squad and the need to improve for the next cycle.

item.title: Do fim da 6 X 1 ao MEI, saiba o que ficará para depois do recesso
item.description: Brazil's legislature is entering its final week before the mid-year recess (July 18–31), with little expectation of significant votes. The PEC to reduce the workweek from 44 to 40 hours (6 X 1) will be postponed until after the recess, making it unlikely to take effect before the October elections, as President Lula desires. Other proposals — including central bank autonomy, special retirement for health agents, raising the MEI revenue cap, and criminalizing misogyny — are also likely to be delayed, as the second half of the year will be dominated by elections, with party conventions from July 20 to August 5 and candidate registration closing on August 15.

item.title: Governo tem pautas importantes travadas no Senado, mas Lula evita aproximação com Alcolumbre
item.description: The Lula government has important pending agendas in the Senate that it aims to approve before the July recess, but avoids approaching Senate President Davi Alcolumbre. Tensions between the Executive and Legislative branches hinder the passage of key measures. The article is subscriber-only.

item.title: Lula faz trocas em equipe do governo para reforçar pré-campanha à reeleição
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will begin staff changes at the Planalto Palace to strengthen his 2026 re-election pre-campaign. Key adjustments include assigning photographer Ricardo Stuckert to coordinate the campaign’s social media and dismissing three press office advisors to handle media relations for the campaign. These moves follow Lula’s intensified public agenda across states, as the electoral blackout period begins this Saturday and official campaigning starts on August 16.

item.title: As reformas são necessárias, mas falta liderança
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, president of the PSD, declared that the Brazilian Republic is rotten and the Powers contaminated by inefficiency, undermining public trust. Ronaldo Caiado, presidential pre-candidate and head of the ticket, agreed, stating that Brazilian politics is dominated by corruption, backroom deals, and illegal and immoral agreements. The statements were made last week but did not lead to concrete actions beyond media coverage.

item.title: Governo Lula aposta em nova reunião e na oferta de redução de alíquotas para barrar tarifaço de Trump
item.description: The Lula government is seeking to avoid a 25% U.S. tariff on Brazilian goods by offering reduced import tariffs on U.S.-dominated sectors and presenting a 'roadmap' covering digital trade, ethanol, deforestation, and other issues. Despite these efforts, officials express pessimism, believing the Trump administration has no interest in granting Lula a political victory ahead of the 2026 elections. There is also concern that the U.S. may support Flávio Bolsonaro’s candidacy, who has already requested a delay in the tariffs, prompting the Brazilian government to prepare a narrative counter if he claims credit for any positive outcome.

item.title: Motta se reúne com bancada do agro e governo e tenta acordo para limitar impacto de pauta-bomba das dívidas rurais
item.description: House Speaker Hugo Motta is seeking an agreement between the ruralist caucus and the Lula government to limit the fiscal impact of rural debt renegotiation, which the original proposal would cost R$140 billion over ten years. The bill, expanded in the Senate to include producers affected by international conflicts like the wars in Ukraine and the Middle East, is considered a 'budget bomb' and will likely be debated only in the second semester after the parliamentary recess, with original rapporteur Afonso Hamm expected to retain his role.

item.title: Lula prepara lançamento oficial de campanha à reeleição para 2 de agosto após maratona de inaugurações
item.description: Lula is preparing to officially launch his re-election campaign on August 2 at the PT convention in São Paulo, following the completion of a series of government inauguration events. The shift from Brasília to São Paulo was made at Lula’s request, as he aims to replicate his 2022 performance in the state, which is seen as pivotal for the election. Until then, he will focus on closed-door sectoral meetings, avoiding public acts that could be construed as premature campaigning under electoral law.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro tenta se desvencilhar de tarifaço de Trump em audiência nos EUA
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) is in the U.S. attending a USTR hearing on proposed tariffs against Brazil, urging the suspension of a 25% duty on Brazilian goods. He argues that the tariffs would politically benefit President Lula rather than pressure his administration, citing past Trump-era tariffs that allegedly boosted Lula’s electoral standing. Bolsonaro also criticized Lula, stating that while the president 'shows the middle finger,' he came to defend Brazilians in the United States.

item.title: Tribunais descumprem decisão do STF sobre penduricalhos e pagam salários de até R$ 495 mil a juízes
item.description: At least seven state courts disregarded an STF ruling that restricted judicial bonuses, paying judges salaries above the constitutional ceiling based on resolutions from the CNJ and CNMP. Payments reached up to R$ 495,000, constituting a direct defiance of the nation’s highest court.

item.title: Empresários brasileiros temem 'efeito Flávio' em audiência nos EUA sobre tarifaço
item.description: Brazilian business leaders fear that remarks by Flávio Bolsonaro and Paulo Figueiredo during the U.S. public hearing on U.S. tariffs against Brazil will inflame tensions and complicate negotiations with the American government.

item.title: Esforço de Lula para atrair trabalhadores de app pode não render resultado nas eleições
item.description: President Lula sought to court app-based workers, but his effort may yield little electoral gain due to the lack of progress on increasing their wages — a key demand for the group. Although these workers are largely perceived as right-leaning, the absence of salary improvements undermines the PT’s outreach strategy. The article suggests that without tangible gains, this political approach may fail to translate into votes in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Eduardo e Flávio culpam PT por eliminação do Brasil na Copa
item.description: Flávio and Eduardo Bolsonaro linked Brazil’s elimination from the 2026 World Cup to the PT, claiming the team hasn’t won a World Cup since the party’s victory in 2002 — despite Brazil’s fifth title occurring under Fernando Henrique Cardoso. Eduardo repeated Flávio’s claim, cited Bruno Guimarães’ missed penalty, and shared a photo of Jair Bolsonaro with the team after the 2019 Copa América, ending with 'We lost the Cup, but we will win the country'.

item.title: Vini Jr. fala sobre pênalti perdido contra a Noruega: “Nunca fugi”
item.description: Vini Jr. explained that the missed penalty in Brazil's elimination against Norway was taken by Bruno Guimarães per coach Carlo Ancelotti's decision, based on statistical performance. He stated he never shirked responsibility and only takes penalties for Real Madrid when selected by the coach.

item.title: Lula pode ficar sem palanque em SP no 2º turno, sinaliza Datafolha
item.description: The latest Datafolha poll in São Paulo suggests Tarcísio de Freitas is likely to defeat Fernando Haddad in the first round of the state election, which could leave President Lula without a strong electoral base in the second round of the presidential race in Brazil’s largest electoral college. This poses a strategic challenge for Lula’s 2026 re-election campaign.

item.title: Neymar indica seu futuro na seleção após eliminação para Noruega
item.description: Neymar suggested that Brazil's elimination to Norway in the Round of 16 of the 2026 World Cup may have been his final appearance for the national team, stating 'I tried, I tried. Now it's over. I started here, I finished here'. The forward scored his ninth World Cup goal and reached 80 goals for Brazil, but could not prevent a 2-1 loss.

item.title: Após eliminação do Brasil, políticos rivalizam sobre papel de Neymar
item.description: Following Brazil's elimination in the Round of 16 of the World Cup, politicians clashed over Neymar's role in the loss. Allies of Jair Bolsonaro, including Flávio Bolsonaro and Mario Frias, defended the player and mourned the team's exit, while critics such as André Janones and Renan Santos blamed Neymar for the team's performance, citing his alleged negative influence and questioning his selection.
